C165.notes: SER EU-SE-001. Obverse Gustaf VI Adolf left · GUSTAF VI ADOLF SVERIGES KONUNG · user shorthand 1973 + photo · Joseph confirmed 1 krona. Last calendar year of his reign — he died 15 Sept 1973; Carl XVI Gustaf took the throne. Stockholm tram / café CuNi at the hinge of a monarchy. Handwritten A on the flip card. Country #27 — first Sweden. Sole Sweden · SER EU-SE-001. Sweden flips now 1.
C165.story: A 1973 1 krona from Sweden. The obverse shows King Gustaf VI Adolf facing left, with the words GUSTAF VI ADOLF SVERIGES KONUNG (Gustaf VI Adolf, King of Sweden); the reverse shows the crowned Swedish arms with the date, 1 KR and the motto PLIKTEN FRAMFÖR ALLT (Duty above all). Struck in copper-nickel.
